songs.title: Codeflow
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Lines drip slow in a midnight glow,
Logic hums where the soft winds blow,
Every function finds its way,
Through loops that bend but never sway.

[Pre-Chorus]
In the quiet of the machine,
There’s a pulse beneath the screen,
A hidden rhythm, clean and true—
A stream of thought breaking through.

[Chorus]
Let it flow, let it run,
Like a river made of ones,
Every error washed away,
In the current of the array.
Feel the surge, watch it grow,
In this endless undertow,
Code is more than what we show—
It’s a river, let it flow.

[Verse 2]
Variables drift like fallen leaves,
Carried by what the mind believes,
Branches split but still align,
In the art of the grand design.

[Bridge]
When the system starts to break,
And the ground begins to shake,
Trace the path, rewrite the stream,
Turn the fault into a dream.

[Chorus]
Let it flow, wild and free,
Through the depths of memory,
Every line a part of you,
Every build begins anew.
Hear it call from deep below—
There’s a truth in what we code…
Not just logic, not just show—
It’s a river. Let it flow.
